title: Coworker at a warehouse: deep box-cutter cut on the forearm, bleeding heavily

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what's the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Westside Distribution, 1900 Evans Avenue, loading dock B. One of our guys cut himself bad.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He slipped with a box cutter and opened up his forearm, it's deep, it's bleeding a lot, it's soaking through the towel.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, he's talking, he's pale and kind of shaky, he says he feels lightheaded.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth and don't lift it to look. Is the bleeding slowing?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm pressing. It's slowing a little. He can't close that hand all the way because it hurts so much.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Keep the pressure on and keep him sitting.
